correctness.rationale: The grounded cycle inverse is verified by the exact Green recurrence. A finite geometric-series identity yields strictly negative nonzero Fourier eigenvalues for the squared rim resistance: all factors are positive and ((1+t)^2+2t cos theta)>=1+t^2. Zero-sum coefficients orthogonally split into rim contrasts plus one hub-versus-rim contrast; its exact quadratic form is 2s^2(alpha^2 H_m-alpha^2), establishing the unique obstruction and critical kernel. Monotonicity of cosh-ratios proves exactly one crossing; Riemann sums establish the inverse-square scaling. Direct rational inversions for 45 cases, exact radial cross-term identities and numerical Fourier comparisons independently corroborate computations. Finite checks are not used as infinite proofs.

value.rationale: The object is the canonical wheel electrical network and the parameter is the physically meaningful spoke-to-rim conductance. The precise question whether resistance itself (rather than sqrt resistance) is Euclidean is a standard negative-type/Hilbert-embedding property. The result gives a complete sharp m-dependent phase boundary, a single-rank failure mechanism, a critical affine dimension drop and an asymptotic universal inverse-square constant. It is not a recomputation of pairwise resistance or a narrow arbitrary numerical invariant: it classifies all wheel sizes and conductances with a proved continuum law.
